Housing conditions in the project region are precarious, and more than 20 % of residents live in poverty. The region is known for being crime-ridden and unsafe, violent crime is on the rise and a large proportion of residents is exposed to environmental risks. The project focuses on close cooperation with organised groups from disadvantaged neighbourhoods, young cultural and women’s collectives, and residents’ organisations to exert political influence.
